address: 409 Mount Eden Road, Mount Eden, Auckland, 1024, New Zealand
bio: Tourists and locals alike flock to this relaxed, family-friendly restaurant which is close to the Mount Eden Scenic Area and is spread over two floors. You can watch the handmade pasta being crafted in the open kitchen, while core ingredients like parmesan and San Marzano tomatoes are imported from Italy for the traditional recipes. Gnocchi is always worth ordering, as is the daily made bread.
